title: [spec-gap][R-12-010] Piggybacked ack_through receipts and 5-min explicit-receipt window absent
description: spec/12-apps.md:113-150 (18.1.2): replies carry ack_through naming highest message ID received (zero-airtime piggyback ACK); explicit receipt POST /msg/ack fires when ack:true and no reply within receipt window (RECOMMENDED 5 min); explicit receipts are themselves custody-transfer messages; senders SHOULD treat ack_through as equivalent receipt for all IDs <= value. Evidence: ack_through absent everywhere — Python allow-list silently drops the key (messaging.py:384-397), Rust InboxPost has no field (msg.rs:89-124), C strict decode rejects unknown keys (coap_msg.c:933-935); no receipt-window timer in any stack; receipts are stored records, never sent. POST /msg/ack endpoint itself conforms (receipt_cbor.json, C coap_msg_ack 10 ZTESTs). Placement: messaging.py + msg.rs + coap_msg.c field/receipt-send logic.
